text_en: Hahaah! They've just saved us from being buried alive in one cave and we've ended up in another.
I think I'll rest for a while.
Am I the only one who thinks this is crazy? A few hours ago we were preparing for battle in... our... world?
Tsk..._300_ He caught me off guard._300_ I don't understand what happened to him. He seemed out of it.

He just started attacking us out of nowhere!_500_
He went crazy!
That was close._300_ Thank goodness you were there.
I'm fine, it's just a scratch._100_ Don't waste time here._100_ You managed to open the door, right?_100_ Well, get a move on then!
Listen... I hope you're not brooding on what you did._300_ If you hadn't stopped it, it would have killed those two.
We'll catch up with you later...
